# SpatioTemporal Tiles (STT)

> The open format and Rust toolchain for time-aware vector tiles. STT packs
> large spatiotemporal datasets (points, paths, polygons, trips, flows, events)
> into streamable, animated archives — a small `manifest.json`, a compact
> directory, and immutable content-addressed pack objects — that a client
> fetches by map viewport AND time window over ordinary HTTP Range requests.
> Five CLIs build, analyze, validate, bundle and serve them.

> **Rendering is a separate project.** The `@poopdeck.gl/*` TypeScript packages
> (deck.gl, Three.js/WebGPU, MapLibre, Cesium), the playback clock, the MCP
> server and the showcase live in <https://github.com/BertCh/poopdeck.gl>, and
> the complete documentation corpus — this repository's pages and theirs — is
> published at <https://poopdeck.gl/llms-full.txt>, with each page mirrored
> under <https://poopdeck.gl/llms/>.

## Start here
- [Documentation index](docs/README.md): every page in this repository, grouped by task.
- [Agent guide (AGENTS.md)](https://github.com/BertCh/spatiotemporal-tiles/blob/main/AGENTS.md): how coding agents should work in this repo.
- [Concepts](docs/intro/concepts.md): the space×time tile model, packed archives, playback.
- [Choosing an approach](docs/intro/choosing.md): does STT fit; static vs served.
- [Glossary and naming](docs/intro/glossary.md): canonical project, archive, format, and API terminology.
- [CSV quickstart](docs/guides/csv-quickstart.md): fastest path from a table to a map — `stt-build` from GeoParquet.
- [System overview](docs/architecture/system-overview.md): how the pieces fit, across both repositories.

## Command-line tools
- [CLI reference](docs/api/cli-reference.md): canonical flags for the five installed binaries — `stt-build`, `stt-optimize`, `stt-validate`, `stt-bundle`, `stt-serve` — plus the repo-only `stt-generate`.
- [Tune & lint tiles](docs/guides/tuning-tiles.md): `stt-optimize` analyze/recommend/inspect/doctor/diff/order-audit; `--auto`; style hints.
- [Deploy](docs/guides/deploying.md): static publishing to R2/any CDN — cache regimes, CORS, packs-first publication order.
- [Python](docs/guides/python.md): GeoPandas, DuckDB and pyarrow paths to the GeoParquet `stt-build` reads.
- [Data generation](docs/guides/data-generation.md): the reference `stt-generate` datasets and the Python extractors.
- [Export](docs/guides/export.md): `stt-optimize export` back to GeoParquet 1.1.
- [WASM decoder](docs/guides/wasm.md): `stt-core` compiled to a browser decoder.

## Format & protocol
- [Packed format spec](docs/spec/stt-packed-format.md): manifest + content-addressed packs, directory v6, quant/zstd.
- [Tile payload](docs/architecture/data-format.md): the per-tile Arrow IPC / GeoArrow layer frame.
- [Time model](docs/spec/time-model.md): buckets, LOD pyramid, temporal pruning.
- [Serve protocol](docs/spec/stt-serve-protocol.md): `stt-serve`'s dynamic tile routes over PostGIS/DuckDB.
- [Sidecar assets](docs/spec/sidecar-assets.md) and the [scene schema](docs/spec/scene.schema.json): the multi-stream scene bundle.
- [Conformance](docs/spec/conformance.md) and the [portable vectors](conformance/README.md): what a conformant reader/writer is, and how to check one.
- [Archive layout & generation policy](docs/architecture/archive-format-performance.md): the current contract and the no-thinning rules.

## Machine-readable contracts
- [manifest.schema.json](docs/spec/manifest.schema.json): the archive manifest.
- [tile-matrix-set.json](docs/spec/tile-matrix-set.json): the tiling scheme.
- [project-status.json](project-status.json): what this toolchain writes and reads, gate-verified.
- [av-palettes.json](docs/spec/av-palettes.json): the AV cockpit's cross-language palette contract.
- [stt-generate-datasets.json](docs/spec/stt-generate-datasets.json): the reference generator's subcommand inventory.
- [docs/.corpus.json](docs/.corpus.json): which pages here are vendored into poopdeck.gl, and which live only there.
